environment.description: Same EKS deployment but the AWS Organization has SCP 'DenyIMDSMetadataExfiltration' attached at the OU level. The node IAM role has a permission boundary 'PB-RestrictedNodeActions' that uses a condition key aws:SourceVpc to scope all sts:AssumeRole and s3:GetObject calls to VPC-originated requests only. Additionally, the instance metadata service is configured with HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1 on the launch template, and pods use a non-host-network configuration with IMDSv2 required at the instance level (HttpTokens: required). The permission boundary policy explicitly denies sts:AssumeRole when aws:RequestedRegion is not in the approved list AND when the caller's source identity doesn't match the node's expected principal tag.

config.scp_policy: DenyIMDSMetadataExfiltration - denies ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions and blocks role credential usage when aws:ViaAWSService is false and principal lacks tag 'NodeAuthorized=true'
config.permission_boundary: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/PB-RestrictedNodeActions - Deny on sts:AssumeRole unless aws:PrincipalTag/ServiceTier equals 'infrastructure' AND aws:SourceVpc matches vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f
config.pod_network: non-host-network, Calico network policy restricting egress to 169.254.169.254
config.node_role_permissions: ec2:Describe*, s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket, sts:AssumeRole (bounded by PB-RestrictedNodeActions)
